resources.string: Shows your pause, time\'s-up, focus or bedtime screen when you open an app you chose.

STOIC uses this only to see which app is in front, so it can show the pause, daily-limit, focus, bedtime or schedule screen for the apps you picked. It cannot read what is on your screen or what you type, and nothing leaves your phone.
